a: Keys the keydown filters refuse are still pressed for `over` bindings when the pointer arrives
A held-key entry outlives its gesture and blocks re-engaging on the next arrival
The hover cursor keeps the in-flight cursor after a gesture ends with no input to carry it
Immediate params drop `bodyKind` for pointerdown, longpress and hover
`ctx.screen` is canvas-local for wheel and pinch, client pixels for everything else
A drop whose items fail to materialize is an unhandled rejection
b: A gesture that ends with no input leaves its active cursor on the canvas until the pointer moves
`heldPointer` is read once at attach, so a later callback never gets the feed and the earlier one never gets `null`
A keystroke that closes a keymap while Cmd is down stays in the `quiet` set after its keyup is lost
Immediate params carry `bodyKind` for some pointer kinds and drop it for others that match on it
